FN is a strong underfollowed manufacturing-platform candidate for 800G/1.6T optical interconnect exposure, even though it is not itself a pure substrate supplier.

node: Precision optical substrates and materials for 800G/1.6T transceivers
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the optical-interconnect substrate/materials node identifies a two-lane universe: reference leaders tied to constrained AI photonics capacity, and underfollowed/speculative suppliers that may benefit if 800G/1.6T optical transceiver qualification cycles and limited commercial-grade substrate supply become binding constraints. Evidence is strongest for Coherent and Lumentum as reference photonics capacity anchors, Fabrinet as a direct manufacturing platform exposed to 800G/1.6T transceiver demand, and Aeluma as a speculative alternative III-V-on-silicon photonics platform. AXT is an important candidate to verify in later passes, but it is not included in the limited list because the provided evidence package does not directly support its current 800G/1.6T qualification or backlog exposure.
